findings.evidence: wyckoff_add derives stop_floor from readiness.lps, but Produced.add_instruction is a mutable dict. Pipeline.bind trusts add['stop_floor'] to construct AddEvidence. No equality is enforced against readiness.lps.bar.low or a source-graph claim. Adversarial synthetic proof changed the source-derived 118 stop floor to 100.0; the add was admitted and campaign protection became 100.0.
findings.required_correction: Replace mutable scalar handoff with an explicit source-bound add-stop claim/proof. Bind the actual LPS bar ID, deterministic derivation and expected price; verify at bind and immediately before fill that add_evidence.lps_low == max(original_stage_stop, live_LPS_bar.low). Make Produced/add payload immutable or integrity-hashed.
findings.revealing_test: Create valid spring stage + actual kernel receipt + later LPS. Mutate any add stop-floor scalar after producer emission. Bind/execution must fail STOP/ADD_PROVENANCE_PARITY rather than admit.
findings.title: Wyckoff staged-add stop floor is mutable and not bound to the actual LPS source

findings.evidence: ContractProducer._emit accepts pit_eligible as a plain bool and event_row stores it as broad_eligible. Pipeline.bind does not parity-check that field against immutable producer/source evidence. bind_producer_event turns the mutable event value directly into row.pit_eligible. Adversarial proof changed False to True before bind; the candidate was admitted and filled in synthetic mode.
findings.required_correction: Represent PIT membership as a Known/source-graph claim with pair/checkpoint/source hash/availability; include its event ID in required evidence and in immutable producer integrity. Pipeline must derive pit_eligible from that live claim, never from a caller-editable event field.
findings.revealing_test: Emit a PIT-ineligible thesis with a bound membership claim=false; mutate event broad_eligible to true. Binding must reject. Terminating the membership source before next open must also reject.
findings.title: PIT membership is a mutable caller boolean, not source-bound evidence

findings.evidence: Produced is a frozen dataclass, but event and add_instruction are mutable dictionaries. self.emitted stores a deep copy, yet normal Pipeline.bind does not verify the supplied Produced object against that emission record. H3 does such an emitted-object check, demonstrating the missing invariant on ordinary routes.
findings.required_correction: Use immutable mappings/typed dataclasses for event authority and add instructions, or add a producer-issued immutable emission digest/claim and verify it on every Pipeline.bind path. Broad eligibility, add stop floor, timestamps, owner and source payload must all be covered.
findings.revealing_test: Mutate every pre-bind mutable field one at a time after _emit. Any semantic mutation must fail; only non-semantic presentation fields, if any, may differ.
findings.title: Frozen Produced wrapper still contains mutable dict payloads before binding
